web-guide-idea-11.audience: Former residents, curious travellers and people interested in rural culture.
web-guide-idea-11.offer: Guide viewers through your village using firsthand knowledge. A small route with three meaningful stops can be more engaging than trying to show everything.
web-guide-idea-11.steps.1: Visit a landmark, a craft or food stop and a public gathering place.
web-guide-idea-11.steps.2: Explain one local custom and invite questions.
web-guide-idea-11.equipment: A phone, reliable mobile data and a power bank. An inexpensive wired microphone can help in windy lanes.
web-guide-idea-11.returnReason: Make each visit about a new theme: water, harvest, crafts or festival preparations. Returning viewers gradually learn the village’s story.
web-guide-idea-11.promotion: Introduce one landmark in a short teaser and explain why it matters to you personally.
web-guide-idea-11.metadataTitle: Apne Gaon Ki Sair — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-11.metadataDescription: Introduce your village through its landmarks, crafts, food and residents who are happy to be on camera. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
